plan.selection_identity_rule: Per task, SHA256(bridge-inner-selection-20261015|shard::record) order; first quarter whole episodes become inner selection. No image/target/error-based choice.
plan.initialization: Fresh43; never initialize from a checkpoint fitted to all64 episodes
plan.model: Original202278 direct x0/DDPM100 recipe with observed-state port; no residual-prior candidate
plan.statistics: Recompute every train-fitted statistic from96 optimization windows only; no inner/outer targets for normalization or any supervised prior
plan.trajectory: One6144-update run,batch8,512 exposures per optimization window; first3072 at1e-4,last3072 at1e-5; no budget extension
plan.selection_rule: Minimize max(inner_episode_equal_position/inner_episode_equal_static_position,inner_episode_equal_rotation/inner_episode_equal_static_rotation),nativeDDPM100 with fixed3 sampling seeds; ties choose earlier step
plan.primary_comparison: Selected checkpoint vs final6144 checkpoint from the SAME96-window training trajectory on original40 outer windows, evaluated only after selection is frozen
plan.fairness: Old128-window runs are background references only; changing actual optimization split prevents attribution against those old runs to selection alone
plan.storage: At most current best and final nonCLIP weights; save all small inner predictions, no optimizer/intermediate weight collection
plan.acceptance: Require selected model to improve both outer mean position and rotation vs same-run final; report comparison to static and all10 episodes. Training error reported, not used to choose checkpoint or force millimetre memorization.
plan.stopping: One fixed selection rule,one trajectory,no automatic extra seeds,regularization changes or new architectures. Negative result closes this specific selection-rule test, not all overfitting explanations.
plan.reason_new_trajectory_needed: Existing128-window series stores only final neural weights and intermediate TRAIN predictions; earlier held-out predictions cannot be recovered from those arrays. Original train.py best.pt selects validation denoising loss, not this independent action-generation selection.

preserve: Frozen growth128 direct x0/DDPM100 modules, initial43, real current-state port, frozenCLIP/gripper; no residual prior.
controls: Within one96-window trajectory selected-vs-final, not a causal comparison against old128-window training.
scaling: Only96 optimization-window current XYZ fit state scaling; action scale0.1m fixed before split, quaternion unchanged. Old128 stats are checked only as raw input provenance and discarded.
cache: May reuse audited full frozen CLIP tokens; encoder has no train-fitted normalization and all weights stay frozen. Cache contains observations only, not actions.
preflight: Eight unobserved updates vs the same eight with inner selection at4/8, exact parameter/loss/Adam replay; selected-file reload must exactly replay32 inner predictions. No outer scoring; temporary selected checkpoint removed.
storage: At most best.pt+final.pt, combined<1200MiB; shared token cache<256MiB; no optimizer checkpoints; no weight/data downloads.
stopping: Exactly one6144-update formal trajectory; no extension even if train fit is poor or selected checkpoint fails outer metrics.
limitations: Original40 outer windows have been reused extensively; this is exploratory development, not an untouched test.
Only pose, no learned gripper or physical robot task success.
Inner and outer labels are decoded by existing identity audit, but never used for optimizer gradients or normalization. Inner labels only select weights; outer labels only score after lock.
